status: Bitmap file/size controls, presets, persisted choices and native slider-derived view-scale reuse are implemented with bounded verification. Remaining viewer geometry and bitmap lifecycle remain unfinished.
nativeChoices: Basic and advanced bitmap widgets own separate bmp/jpg/png/tif format, directory and expansion choices. Default format is png; both default collapsed. Both share the model's bitmap scale. Existing cold/source/reset preference captures remain authoritative.
nativeControlReference: New helper 34 only reads descendants, object names, text, enabled state and QSpinBox/QDoubleSpinBox values/ranges/steps/decimals on both bitmap widgets. Source processing and scale updates use existing model business methods. Earlier 33 executables remain frozen. No native input, widget setter or dialog answer is permitted.
implementationIntent: Use the canonical openvector/bitmap exporter through the GUI worker. Preserve independent basic/advanced choices and shared scale, native source/reset effects, persisted choices and explicit save decisions. Keep the existing preview untouched; validate in an owned isolated build.
downloadContract: GET /api/export accepts bmp/jpg/jpeg/png/tif/tiff through the canonical exportBitmap owner, with optional JSON numeric scale and boolean flatten query values. Bitmap options do not alter vector export preferences. BITMAP_FLATTEN_REQUIRED crosses the worker and HTTP boundary as a coded 400 response with current state; no file bytes are returned before acknowledgement. Downloads are owned attachments with no-store caching. Bitmap default names append _vectorized to the source basename without its final extension, then use the filename field's first-dot truncation. Measured names: image.bmp -> image_vectorized, tall.bmp -> tall_vectorized, multi.part.bmp -> multi.
pending: Native viewer center/scrollbar geometry, exact wheel-anchor arithmetic, preprocessing/batch field lifetimes, native correction-cycle behavior, arbitrary filesystem equivalence and native error notifications remain unverified or unfinished.
verification: ../evidence/bitmap-scale-verification-checkpoint.json records the current scale-producer integration, read-only native catalog/view observations, three additional native PNG files, build/source identity and remaining failures.
visualIntent: Reuse the established true-black, dense OpenVector wizard and shadcn controls. Design references are recorded in evidence/bitmap-gui-ui-design-reference.json. Do not introduce decorative cards, pills, gradients or motion.
bitmapChoicesContract: GET/POST /api/bitmapSave owns basic and advanced bmp/jpg/png/tif format, directory, filename and expansion. PNG and collapsed are defaults. The existing QuickSave filename/directory owner is shared with an explicit bitmap kind; vector format admission remains unchanged. Image source events assign the suffixed basename and containing folder to both bitmap panes; blank source changes retain names and move folders to the working directory parent.
persistenceContract: The canonical processing preference object contains bitmapSave with basic/advanced choices and one shared finite scale. Filenames and field text are session-only. Startup applies the saved scale through the same cold 150 by 250 correction handlers. Older local files fail with an explicit recovery message; no automatic migration or alternate schema is accepted.
renderedContract: A separate Bitmap Export disclosure renders the current pane format, width/height fields with native small and large step commands, and percentage text. Blur and Enter commit through the worker numeric parser. A queued download waits for preceding field/format commits, fetches the canonical bitmap attachment and uses its server-owned filename. BITMAP_FLATTEN_REQUIRED opens the native OK-only Will Flatten Image warning; acknowledgement resumes the download. Directory, filename and Save controls use the shared save transaction.
directSaveContract: POST /api/quickSaveFile uses command save, kind vector/bitmap and mode basic/advanced. One pending transaction owns target and bytes across cancellable directory/overwrite decisions. A required bitmap transparency warning follows those decisions; command acknowledge accepts this OK-only warning. A decide request cannot cancel or skip it. All mutations remain locked while pending. Direct files use the selected pane filename/folder/format and shared scale; only successful writes show Saved for five seconds.
directoryPickerContract: POST quickSaveDirectory requires kind vector/bitmap and mode, and uses the existing host folder picker. Its reply contains that kind’s owned basic/advanced choices. The observer never drives native pickers.
directSaveLimit: Rendered bytes are prepared before file decisions, preserving the transaction across direct-engine use. No target is written before directory/overwrite decisions and required acknowledgement finish. Native task scheduling, error-notification timing and unusual filesystem equivalence remain unverified.
